name: Ye Jian
profile: Listed on the Hurun China Rich List 2014-2021 (with Ye Zhehua) with wealth from 'Kunlun' in real estate and investment (~US$470m). Searches could not tie this name to a specific Kunlun-branded company; there are several unrelated Kunlun groups (Kunlun Tech, Kunlun Energy, etc.).
notes: Identity not confirmed: the Kunlun entity behind this Hurun listing could not be identified; do not assume a link to Kunlun Tech or Kunlun Energy. No public contacts found.

name: Hong Jiangyou
current_role: Chairman and President, Honz Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (康芝药业, SZSE: 300086), re-elected Dec 2025
profile: Born 1964 in Puning, Guangdong; pharmacy graduate (Guangdong College of Pharmacy, 1988) who left a state pharmacist job in Shenzhen to found Hainan-based Honz Pharmaceutical, a children's-medicine maker listed on ChiNext. He controls ~20% of the company and was re-elected chairman for a three-year term in December 2025.
interesting_fact: He has pitched Honz around a single mission, 'children's great health' (儿童大健康), and has said he won't retire until it is complete; the firm specialises in paediatric drugs.
deep_cut_fact: A keen Go player since university, he chairs the Hainan Provincial Go Culture Promotion Association and says Go's opening stage shapes how he makes business decisions; Honz sponsored a children's Go training camp in Guangzhou.
notes: Also chairs the International Teochew (Chaozhou) Business Federation 21st council and the Hainan overseas-Chinese business federation. Company has been loss-making in 2024-25. Best route: the board secretary (Lin Dexin) through the IR email.

name: Prakash P Chhabria
current_role: Executive Chairman, Finolex Industries Ltd (PVC pipes, fittings and resin), Pune
profile: Son of Finolex Group founder Pralhad P. Chhabria (group founded 1958). He joined the Finolex Industries board in 1992 and became Executive Chairman in 2012, building it into one of India's leading PVC pipe brands with a backward-integrated resin plant near Ratnagiri. He also holds a stake in Finolex Cables, the group's original business.
interesting_fact: Finolex Industries is backward-integrated: it runs its own PVC resin plant near Ratnagiri (set up 1994) supplied through an open-sea jetty it operates for raw materials; he is also a director of Pawas Port Ltd.
deep_cut_fact: He studied international business at the University of Evansville in Indiana, USA, and in FY2021-22 received an honorary D.Litt. from Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth, Pune, for his contributions to society.
notes: Source_of_wealth says Finolex Cables, but his executive role is at Finolex Industries; Finolex Cables is run by another branch of the family, so avoid conflating them. CSR is via Mukul Madhav Foundation. marcom@ is the company marketing-communications address.

name: Yao Hong
current_role: Founder of Weidai (微贷网), Hangzhou; current role/status unclear since the platform wound down in 2020-21
profile: Hangzhou entrepreneur (born c.1980) who founded Weidai in 2010, a P2P lender that pivoted to car-collateral loans in 2012 and listed on the NYSE in 2018. The platform exited online lending in 2020 and came under a Hangzhou police illegal-deposit-taking investigation; Weidai reported repaying all outstanding investor principal by mid-2021. No recent public information on him.
interesting_fact: He started his first business in 2001 at 21 with three friends and 5,000 yuan; he says he struggled to borrow 500 yuan for inventory and a classmate lent it on the 20th call. He framed Weidai as a lender for small entrepreneurs like his younger self.
notes: Sensitive: Weidai has been under police investigation since July 2020 (https://m.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_17363197). Status unknown; Hurun listings ended 2019. Not a good outreach target; no public contacts found.

name: Fu Guoping
profile: Listed on the Hurun China Rich List 2013-2017 (with Yang Xiaowei), with ~US$420m from 'Jinfu' (金富?) in electro-optic products. Searches could not identify the company or confirm the person.
notes: Identity not confirmed: no public record found linking 富国平 to a Jinfu electro-optics company. No contacts found.

name: Charles Craig Carlton
current_role: Manager of the general partner of C.C. Carlton Industries, Ltd. (now an AIAI subsidiary); 5%+ holder of AIAI Holdings Corp (Nasdaq: AIAI)
profile: Texas civil-construction businessman behind C.C. Carlton Industries, a Central Texas site and civil contractor founded in 1993 (subdivisions, commercial, hospital and industrial sites). AIAI Holdings acquired the firm on its May 2026 Nasdaq direct listing, leaving Carlton with ~13.4m Class A shares via The Love Bug Trust, its largest disclosed holder.
interesting_fact: C.C. Carlton is AIAI's first test bed for its 'Transformational AI' strategy: in July 2026 AIAI deployed an AI 'Bid Accelerator' to speed up Carlton's construction estimating.
deep_cut_fact: Per AIAI's S-1, C.C. Carlton Industries (founded 1993) carries a $200 million bonding capacity, up to $50 million on any single job, and is run by Craig Carlton as GP manager together with CEO Benjamin Lyon.

public_contacts.value: AIAI investor relations: Matthew Selinger, Integrous Communications, mselinger@integcom.us

notes: Low public profile; the wealth figure reflects the AIAI share price. Relevant for AI-in-construction or data-center site-work angles. Best route is via AIAI IR or C.C. Carlton (Austin, TX).

name: Qian Zhida
current_role: Chairman, Brother Enterprises Holding Co., Ltd. (兄弟科技, SZSE: 002562), re-elected Sept 2026 for 2026-2029
profile: Born 1967; senior economist and controlling shareholder of Brother Enterprises, a Haining, Zhejiang chemicals group founded in 1991 and listed in 2011. It started in leather chemicals and now spans vitamins (K3, B1, niacinamide), flavours, APIs, catalysts and chromium salts, with plants in Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Jiangxi and South Africa. He was formerly also its president.
interesting_fact: Brother bought Lanxess's chrome chemicals business (CISA), giving it a sodium dichromate and chromic acid plant in Newcastle, South Africa, and a fully integrated global chromium supply chain.
deep_cut_fact: Beyond vitamins, Brother is a maker of the synthetic vanilla flavours vanillin and ethyl vanillin, sold to food and household-products makers.
notes: Low media profile. Best route: board secretary Qian Liuhua via stock@brother.com.cn. Web-search budget ran out mid-lane, so only filings and the company site were used.

name: J. David Phillips
current_role: Senior Managing Director and Co-Head of North America, Providence Equity Partners (Boston)
profile: Private-equity investor who joined Providence Equity in 2005 and co-leads its North American investing, sitting on its investment, portfolio-review and executive committees. The SEC 'ten percent owner' tag for DoubleVerify (DV) comes from his role among the Providence fund entities that held the DV stake, not a personal 10% holding. Boards include Asurion, Accelerate Learning, Seesaw and Tenstreet.
interesting_fact: Before private equity he was a Luce Scholar and assistant director of business development at Hutchison Whampoa in China, after earlier work in Goldman Sachs' principal investment area; Princeton BA, Harvard MBA.
deep_cut_fact: His past board seats include PADI, the Professional Association of Diving Instructors, the world's largest scuba-diver training organisation, alongside Ascend Learning, Vistage and Worldwide Express.
notes: Insider filings list him with Providence entities (e.g. SEC Form 4, 2026-05-22, DoubleVerify). The listed net worth probably reflects fund-held DV shares rather than his personal wealth. Based in Providence's Boston office.

name: Wu Yinhe
current_role: Non-executive Director, Xinyi Glass Holdings (HKEX: 0868); Executive Director, Xinyi Electric Storage Holdings (HKEX GEM: 8328)
profile: One of the early shareholder-directors of Xinyi Glass, which was founded in 1988 and is now a Hang Seng Index constituent making float, automotive and low-e architectural glass. Known in Hong Kong filings as NG Ngan Ho (aged 61 in the 2025 annual report), he joined the group in 2003, ran finance and purchasing at the Dongguan complex, and holds his shares through Linkall Investment Ltd.
interesting_fact: Xinyi Glass says it has about 14% of global float-glass capacity, more than 25% of the global automotive replacement-glass market and 25% of the global low-e energy-efficient glass market.
deep_cut_fact: Besides glass, he is an executive director of Xinyi Electric Storage, the group's listed energy-storage and EV-battery-related arm, which is relevant to an energy-focused podcast.
notes: Matching 吴银河 to 'NG Ngan Ho' rests on the Cantonese romanisation plus the Xinyi Glass/Hurun 2021 link; the Chinese name was not machine-readable in the annual report PDF. Low profile; route via Xinyi IR.
